reason: Most of my orders come from old buyers who just call me, and the new ones come through IndiaMART, which I already pay for and answer from my phone. Quoting is not where I am losing business, so Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for a website and a quote desk does not solve a problem I actually have.
objection: I already pay IndiaMART every year. Now one more monthly bill from a small remote studio I have never heard of, with one chemical client to show, and I am not sure a website brings me even one extra order. And my rates change by quantity and buyer, so I doubt a quote drafted from a price list will be right without me redoing it.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a trader like me that it brought real new orders, for example a few months of numbers showing more enquiries converted to quotes, and a trial where I pay the monthly only after I see it working.
